item.title: The Wandering Physicist
item.description: Luis Alvarez brought a scientific pragmatism to many of the twentieth century’s greatest mysteries, including the secrets of pyramids, the Kennedy assassination, and the disappearance of the dinosaurs.

item.title: Deeper Than They Thought
item.description: Although Margaret Kennedy has been largely forgotten as a popular writer, in her novels she wielded the most cunning techniques of literary modernism.

item.title: Home Free
item.description: “Every writer, sooner or later, must face the fact that our characters are taken directly from our own lives, so there will be friends, relatives, and acquaintances who are going to feel like they’ve been pushed under the bus.”

item.title: Timekeepers
item.description: Brazil’s military dictatorship, which lasted from 1964 to 1985, retaliated fiercely against whoever contested its monopoly over the country’s public image. Opponents of the regime were kidnapped, tortured, and in some cases disappeared. Artworks deemed subversive or morally corrupt were banned and censored, if not destroyed. item.title: Trading with the Enemy
item.description: Friday’s Supreme Court decision rebuffing President Trump’s signature foreign policy initiative—worldwide tariffs imposed pursuant to an asserted national emergency—was extraordinary in multiple respects.
